Honest Gaps

What Is Left, And How It Closes Today

Where This System Came From

When this project started, the demo you saw was a different tool — OneUp. It looked easy, and in one way it was: you could ask Claude for ten posts and it would pull the photos from Google Drive and schedule all ten in one chat. What it couldn’t do was approvals — the version at $25 a month has no approval step at all, and the version with approvals is $60 a month. So the system you have now is built on Outstand instead, at $19 a month, with the approval step built into the Sheet you already use.

1The One Gap — The Connection

Outstand is the service that actually sends your posts to Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram. Claude connects to it through a standard plug called MCP.

When we tried to connect it last night, the sign-in worked but the handshake failed three times. The most likely cause: the operator’s Outstand login isn’t a member of your Outstand organization yet, so the connector can’t see your three accounts.

Today’s first check: you invite the operator into your organization, we reconnect, and we prove it live.

2The Image Step — Why The Sheet Does It

Outstand’s connector can write the post, but it can’t take a photo straight from a chat — the photo has to be uploaded to Outstand first, and a chat window can’t do that upload.

The OneUp demo didn’t have this problem, because its connector takes the photo from a Drive link. Here, the Sheet handles it: when you approve a post, the Sheet sends the photo to Outstand and books the post. That’s not extra scope — it’s the step that makes automatic publishing work at all.

3What Today Proves

  • 1The connection works.
  • 2You approve a real post and watch it book to all three networks.
  • 3You book a second one yourself.

What we haven’t proven yet: a post actually going live, and the system booking on its own overnight — both come after today’s proof.

MCP Vs Sheet

Two Pieces, Each Doing The Job It Is Built For

Built To Save You The Subscription.

The first demo you saw ran on a tool whose version with approvals costs $60 a month. This system does the same job for $19 a month, because the Sheet and the script do the step the connector cannot.

That is the inventive part, and it was done on purpose: keep the approval step yours, and keep the monthly bill down.

Saves $41 A Month Saves $492 A Year Approval Step Stays Yours

The MCP — Claude’s Direct Connection

For Drafting And Checking

  • Claude connects straight to Outstand through a standard plug called MCP.
  • It drafts captions and reads the state of your posts.
  • What it cannot do: take a photo from a chat — no tool in it accepts a file, and the upload needs a direct file transfer a chat window cannot do.

The Sheet — Approval And Booking

For Approving And Publishing

  • The Sheet is the approval gate — your Decision pick is the approval.
  • When you approve a post, the script sends the photo to Outstand and books the post to Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram.
  • Booking never needed the MCP at all. The script is the piece that makes automatic publishing work.

Connection Fix Order

Test Each Step In Order And Stop At The First That Works.

  • 1In the chat, turn the connector on: “+” then Connectors then the Outstand toggle.
  • 2Check Outstand’s plan is active in Armand’s Outstand dashboard — Outstand answers “402 Payment Required” without an active subscription.
  • 3Check the organization picked at sign-in is the one holding the three accounts — the connector only has access to the organization you approved; to change it, remove and re-add the connector.
  • 4Remove the connector in Customize then Connectors, reconnect, sign in once.
  • 5Ask Outstand support with the exact error text.

Operator Notes

An operator decision, not a client-facing step:

  • 5Still failing after the steps above: the Owner re-adds it in Organization settings then Connectors with the API key as a request header (Authorization: Bearer) instead of OAuth — the key stays in the admin setting, never in a chat; everyone on the Team then shares that one credential.
One Thing To Be Clear On: the connection fix on today’s agenda is about the MCP handshake — it is what lets Claude draft captions and read post state. Booking runs separately: the Sheet’s script books through Outstand’s API, and booking was proven by this morning’s test. Publishing is proven today.

How To Use The System

Five Steps, Start To Finish

1

Drop The Photo

Crew drops jobsite photos in the Photo Drop folder, in the right bucket: Duct, Equipment, Rooftop, Service, Finish.

2

Claude Drafts The Caption

Three times a day (10 AM, 2 PM, 6 PM) Claude reads the new photos and drafts a caption for each in the Sheet.

3

You Approve In The Sheet

You read the caption, pick a Decision: Approve, Approve Edited, Needs Changes, Hold, or Reject. Your pick is the approval.

4

The Script Books It

When you approve a post, the script books it to Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram. Approved posts publish automatically through Outstand.

5

Booked Rows File To Ready To Post

After booking, the sweeps file booked rows to Ready To Post. Posted photos then move to Posted and Archive, and the Sheet keeps the record.
